evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Resolve actionable Go TODO/FIXME debt and remove genuinely dead code.
intent.acceptance: A removed nonexported top-level Go function, other than init, is independently established unreachable in its complete prior package across every retained build/test variant. Require native parsing and no identifier use beyond its declaration (including recursion, function values, tests and receiver expressions); no cgo, assembly, opaque linker objects or compiler/linker entry directives affecting that package; complete repository-wide linkname/entry-directive scrutiny. A deletion alone, textual reference search, TODO removal, merge or fixture is not evidence. Unsupported or missing source is null. This partial establishes removal of unreachable private code only, not all behavior preservation.

evidence.opportunity: A removed nonexported top-level Go function, other than init, is independently established unreachable in its complete prior package across every retained build/test variant. Require native parsing and no identifier use beyond its declaration (including recursion, function values, tests and receiver expressions); no cgo, assembly, opaque linker objects or compiler/linker entry directives affecting that package; complete repository-wide linkname/entry-directive scrutiny. A deletion alone, textual reference search, TODO removal, merge or fixture is not evidence. Unsupported or missing source is null. This partial establishes removal of unreachable private code only, not all behavior preservation.
filters: Selected retained issue/PR implementations; no complete workflow outcome population.
Missing native facts and no-case periods are null, not zero.
Fixed-reference retrospective assessment, not backdated current policy.
evidence.collection: Offline original Git Merkle-path verification and pinned native Go AST analysis; target code remains data.
evidence.authoring: Source-informed fixed-reference retrospective assessment. Coordinator candidate descriptions were already exposed; no claim of blind authoring. This contract precedes local candidate discovery and native result inspection.

model.architecture: Source-goal-native deterministic structural proof, with strict acceptance and behavioral safeguards separate.
